Dashboard

Per-Project Dashboard — All your KPIs, on one screen.

From total task count to health score, your project's status is clear at a glance.

All your KPIs, on one screen

Total tasks, incomplete, delayed, completion rate, planned hours, health score (A–F)

Previous/Last-Week Comparison View

Displays 7 kinds of edits — priority, milestone, category, start date, and more — in a table format

See your momentum with velocity

The last 12 weeks of completed hours as a bar chart, with an average line

Resolve unassigned tasks on the spot

Assign instantly from the assignee dropdown. Grouped by parent task

Your project's status, right now, on one screen.

The health score and comparison view make checking your status before a report a whole lot faster.

Backlog My Tasks

A Chrome extension that lets you check and manage all your assigned Backlog tasks across multiple spaces in one place. With 7 display views and a Project Dashboard, everyday task management and tracking team progress become effortless.
